stories.title: This tiny Icelandic church hides a Viking story 🇮🇸 #shorts
stories.description:
Hellnakirkja – the little church of Hellnar on Iceland's Snæfellsnes peninsula, consecrated in 1945.

Just down the road, at Laugarbrekka, Guðríður Þorbjarnardóttir was born around 980 AD. She sailed to Greenland and on to Vinland in North America – about 500 years before Columbus. Her son Snorri is traditionally regarded as the first child of European descent born in the Americas.

📍 Hellnar, Snæfellsnes, Iceland 🇮🇸
